derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
def: literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate

occurrences.text: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
